# RFC 8785 test-vector provenance

`appendix-b.tsv` is a mechanical transcription of Table 1, “ECMAScript-Compatible JSON Number Serialization Samples,” from [RFC 8785](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8785.html#appendix-B), published June 2020.

RFC 8785 copyright belongs to the IETF Trust and the identified authors. The source is distributed under the [IETF Trust Legal Provisions](https://trustee.ietf.org/license-info/) in effect for that publication. This repository vendors only the hexadecimal inputs and expected JSON representations needed for conformance testing; NaN and Infinity rows, whose expected representation is deliberately empty, are covered by the adjacent rejection oracle.
